lessons.keep: Give a company origin story one tangible analogy and a clear personal goal.
lessons.avoid: Explaining the founder’s reason for starting while leaving the buyer’s reason to hire unclear.
lessons.open: Service scope, customer deliverables, historical claims and audio remain unverified.
